text: Better icons for the forecast periods taking into account sunlight. And changelog!
Improved times on the rain graph and showing interval duration on tap. Fixed 'Updated' showing an older time than actual data fetch/calculation.
9:00 option for the morning forecast, visual improvements and improved rain graph.
Hour-by-hour temperatures now available. New locations added. Faster site loading and refresh-on-open. The UV index only shows from 3 up.
Custom morning forecast times and opt-out weekend notifications. Fixed morning forecast not using latest rain radar.
